The module in [test/orders.js](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js:1) exports four order helpers:

- `calcTotal(items)` sums `price * qty` across line items.
- `applyDiscount(total, code)` applies a fixed percentage discount for `SAVE10` or `SAVE20`.
- `averageItemPrice(items)` computes an average from the order total and item count.
- `formatOrder(order)` renders the order lines plus a final total string.

Bugs I can verify:

- `calcTotal` has an off-by-one bug in the loop condition at [line 5](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js:5). It uses `i <= items.length`, so the last iteration reads `items[items.length]`, which is `undefined`.
- That immediately breaks [line 6](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js:6) because it tries to access `.price` and `.qty` on `undefined`. As written, `calcTotal` throws for any input, including an empty array.
- `formatOrder` depends on `calcTotal` at [line 25](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js:25), so it will also fail until `calcTotal` is fixed.
- `averageItemPrice` at [line 20](/C:/Users/Kerim/AppData/Local/Temp/codex-eco-bench-Qj3OBM/test/orders.js:20) returns `NaN` for an empty list because it divides by `items.length` with no guard.

I did not run the test suite; this is based on static inspection.
